entities.summary: Alicia Koplowitz y Romero de Juseu is a Spanish billionaire business magnate and former noblewoman who held the title of Marchioness of Bellavista until her distant cousin María Elena de Cárdenas gained the title after the Supreme Court of Spain ruled that Cárdenas had more rights to the title than Koplowitz.
